title: United Airlines says it has "resolved a technology issue that delayed flight departures", adding that the outage did not impact flights already in progress (Michele Luhn/CNBC)
summary: Michele Luhn / CNBC: United Airlines says it has “resolved a technology issue that delayed flight departures”, adding that the outage did not impact flights already in progress — United Airlines on Monday said it had resolved a “widespread system outage” that briefly affected departing flights.
contentText:
Michele Luhn / CNBC :

United Airlines says it has “resolved a technology issue that delayed flight departures”, adding that the outage did not impact flights already in progress   —  United Airlines on Monday said it had resolved a “widespread system outage” that briefly affected departing flights.
